name: trailing-directive
description: A directive that follows the code on the line where a declaration begins binds that declaration and nothing on the next line: a one-line constant is held by it, a constant on the next line stays reported, and a constant whose line sits under a marker comment another tool reads is held by the directive beside it. A directive trailing a call, on a line where no declaration begins, binds nothing and is stale, and the declaration after the function stays reported.
